details:
This update for haproxy fixes the following issues

- Update to version 3.2.21+git0.dbe43be37
- CVE-2026-55203: integer overflow vulnerability in the fcgi_conn structure's drl field that allows buffer misparse as new FCGI record headers (bsc#1268557).
- CVE-2026-55204: null pointer dereference vulnerability in hpack_dht_insert() within src/hpack-tbl.c (bsc#1268558).

package.name: haproxy
package.ecosystem: SUSE:Linux Enterprise Server for SAP applications 16.0
